key_decisions: THE LESSON OF THIS SESSION: a failure reported inside the user's own work-in-progress was NOT caused by it. The bench LTX crash landed while the user was adding last-frame-only, and it read as their bug — but the offending link had been in the shipped graphs since 2026-07-22 and the breakage came from a ComfyUI commit three days later. The tell was cheap and was almost skipped: check whether the failing wiring is OLDER than the edit being blamed. git had the answer in one command.

The KJNodes fix is version-agnostic — `getattr(latent_upscale_model, 'model', latent_upscale_model)` handles both the patcher and the bare module. So the pin bump fixes the engine AS IT STANDS on 0.30.0; the separate engine bump to 0.30.2 the user wants neither fixes nor re-breaks this.

The ENGINE is 0.30.0, the BENCH is v0.30.2 (a real tag on origin/release/v0.30, not a nightly). The version NUMBER is not the discriminator for this bug — 0.30.0 already contains the breaking commit. Read the file, not the version.

MPI-463 was fixed structurally, not eleven times over. A helper every bail routes through makes a TWELFTH bail safe by construction — which matters, because unwired-one-at-a-time is exactly how eleven accumulated.

The user's end-frame gate is now `has img2` (end frame present), NOT both-frames. That is correct because #606/#601 handle the start-present-or-not case inside the chain. The Set is still NAMED `is flf`, which is now a lie — renaming it to `use end guide` is 7 widget edits and was deliberately left to the user mid-test.

MPI-466's shape came from the USER, and it is better than the framing offered to them: rather than choosing dev OR distilled, ship dev int8 and reconstruct distilled at runtime with the rank-111 LoRA — which is exactly what Krea 2 already does to avoid a second download.
constraints: NEVER hand-edit a repo workflow JSON. generate_*.py + node scripts/sync-raw-workflows.mjs own comfy_workflows/. (The BENCH authoring template was hand-edited this session at the user's explicit request — that file is theirs, not generated output.)
js/services/*.js is RENDERER code — Ctrl+Shift+R (a plain Ctrl+R can serve a CACHED ES module). routes/*.js is SERVER code and needs a full app restart.
routes/ reads dev_configs/node_lock.json through a CACHED createRequire — a pin change is invisible to a running server. Always restart before trusting /engine/deps-status.
